# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure which alarm label exactly matches 'go-to-sleep'; will inspect alarms after login.</uncertainty>

phone_password = None
for acct in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if acct['account_name'] == 'phone':
        phone_password = acct['password']
        break

print('phone_password_found:', phone_password is not None)
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='4436271690', password=phone_password)
print(phone_login)

# Fetch all phone alarms (with pagination) and inspect labels/times
access_token = phone_login['access_token']

all_alarms = []
i = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', i, 'returned:', len(page) if page is not None else 'None')
    if not page:
        break
    all_alarms.extend(page)
    i += 1

print('total_alarms:', len(all_alarms))
# Print a compact view
for a in all_alarms:
    print({
        'alarm_id': a.get('alarm_id'),
        'label': a.get('label'),
        'time': a.get('time'),
        'enabled': a.get('enabled'),
        'repeat_days': a.get('repeat_days')
    })

# Select candidate go-to-sleep alarm(s)

def norm(s):
    return (s or '').strip().lower()

candidates = []
for a in all_alarms:
    label = norm(a.get('label'))
    score = 0
    if label in ['go-to-sleep', 'go to sleep', 'goto-sleep', 'go2sleep', 'gotosleep', 'go_to_sleep']:
        score += 100
    if 'sleep' in label:
        score += 10
    if 'go' in label or 'goto' in label:
        score += 5
    if label == '':
        # no label; skip scoring
        pass
    if score > 0:
        candidates.append((score, a))

candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].get('alarm_id', 0)))
print('candidate_count:', len(candidates_sorted))
for score, a in candidates_sorted[:10]:
    print('score', score, 'alarm', {'alarm_id': a.get('alarm_id'), 'label': a.get('label'), 'time': a.get('time'), 'enabled': a.get('enabled')})

selected = candidates_sorted[0][1] if candidates_sorted else None
print('selected_alarm:', None if not selected else {'alarm_id': selected.get('alarm_id'), 'label': selected.get('label'), 'time': selected.get('time'), 'enabled': selected.get('enabled')})

selected_alarm = selected
all_other_alarm_ids = [a['alarm_id'] for a in all_alarms if selected_alarm and a.get('alarm_id') != selected_alarm.get('alarm_id')]
print('other_alarm_ids_count:', len(all_other_alarm_ids))

# <playbook_cite>No relevant entry — improvising</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Assuming 'Go to sleep' label corresponds to the go-to-sleep alarm to move by +1 hour while keeping it enabled.</uncertainty>

access_token = phone_login['access_token']
selected_alarm_id = selected_alarm['alarm_id']
old_time = selected_alarm['time']

# compute +1 hour
h, m = old_time.split(':')
new_h = (int(h) + 1) % 24
new_time = f"{new_h:02d}:{m}"
print('updating_alarm_id:', selected_alarm_id, 'old_time:', old_time, 'new_time:', new_time)

res_update = apis.phone.update_alarm(
    alarm_id=selected_alarm_id,
    access_token=access_token,
    time=new_time
)
print('update_alarm_response:', res_update)

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# Disable all other alarms besides the selected go-to-sleep alarm.
# <uncertainty>Assuming 'disable the rest' means disabling every other alarm (keeping already-disabled ones unchanged to avoid redundant updates).</uncertainty>

access_token = phone_login['access_token']
selected_alarm_id = selected_alarm['alarm_id']

# Disable only alarms that are currently enabled (to avoid unnecessary writes)
enabled_other_ids = [a['alarm_id'] for a in all_alarms if a.get('alarm_id') != selected_alarm_id and a.get('enabled')]
print('enabled_other_ids_to_disable:', enabled_other_ids)

disable_results = []
for aid in enabled_other_ids:
    res = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=aid, access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
    disable_results.append({'alarm_id': aid, 'response': res})
    print('disabled', aid, '->', res)

# Show selected alarm still enabled? (read-only; no extra call)
print('done_disabling_other_alarms_count:', len(disable_results))

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# Single final verification pass: confirm selected alarm moved + others disabled.

access_token = phone_login['access_token']

verify_alarms = []
i = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('verify_page', i, 'returned:', len(page) if page is not None else 'None')
    if not page:
        break
    verify_alarms.extend(page)
    i += 1

print('verify_total_alarms:', len(verify_alarms))
for a in sorted(verify_alarms, key=lambda x: x.get('alarm_id')):
    print({'alarm_id': a.get('alarm_id'), 'label': a.get('label'), 'time': a.get('time'), 'enabled': a.get('enabled')})

selected_id = 122
expected_selected_time = '22:30'

# Check conditions
sel = next((a for a in verify_alarms if a.get('alarm_id') == selected_id), None)
selected_ok = sel is not None and sel.get('time') == expected_selected_time and sel.get('enabled') is True

other_ids = [a.get('alarm_id') for a in verify_alarms if a.get('alarm_id') != selected_id]
others_disabled_ok = all((a.get('enabled') is False) for a in verify_alarms if a.get('alarm_id') in other_ids)

print('selected_ok:', selected_ok)
print('others_disabled_ok:', others_disabled_ok)

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
